false_negative_reasoning: The removed encoded-only child has real cmd ancestry but lacks the refined PowerShell conditions; its shell also lacks the required service-origin branch. No encoded payload is decoded or executed. Missing support and alternate execution paths can hide valid technique activity. Standalone refined PowerShell and other-branch shell candidates remain visible; absence from a correlation is not a benign verdict.
false_positive_reasoning: cmd.exe, PowerShell and service installation each have common administrative uses. Exact independently observed ancestry, service-origin context, ordering and refined behaviour make a much narrower candidate set. Authorized marker-file tests and service wrappers can still satisfy all conditions. Routine-looking inventory, directory and service commands remain ambiguous once parent context and unverified authorization are considered.

powershell_baseline.count_query:
FROM windows-apt-events-*
| WHERE event.provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" AND event.code == "1"
    AND TO_LOWER(process.name) IN ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| STATS total_rows = COUNT(*)

historical_time_range.precision: nanoseconds; absent timestamps excluded only from min/max

powershell_refined.count_query:
FROM windows-apt-events-*
| WHERE event.provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" AND event.code == "1"
    AND TO_LOWER(process.name) IN ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| EVAL command_lc = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(process.command_line, ""))
| EVAL retrieval = command_lc RLIKE ".*(invoke-webrequest|downloadstring|downloadfile|[^a-z0-9_]iwr[^a-z0-9_]).*",
    execution = command_lc RLIKE ".*(invoke-expression|[^a-z0-9_]iex[^a-z0-9_]|start-process).*",
    hidden = command_lc RLIKE ".*[ ]-(w|windowstyle)[ ]+hidden([ ].*)?",
    no_profile = command_lc RLIKE ".*[ ]-(nop|noprofile)([ ].*)?",
    inline_command = command_lc RLIKE ".*[ ]-(c|command)[ ]+.*"
| WHERE (retrieval AND execution) OR (hidden AND no_profile AND inline_command)
| STATS total_rows = COUNT(*)

historical_time_range.precision: nanoseconds; absent timestamps excluded only from min/max

service_config_baseline.count_query:

    AND TO_LOWER(COALESCE(process.command_line, "")) LIKE "*binpath=*"
| STATS total_rows = COUNT(*)

historical_time_range.precision: nanoseconds; absent timestamps excluded only from min/max

shell_refined.count_query:
FROM windows-apt-events-*
| WHERE event.provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" AND event.code == "1"
    AND TO_LOWER(process.name) == "cmd.exe"
| EVAL command_lc = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(process.command_line, ""))
| EVAL service_parent_interpreter = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(process.parent.name, "")) == "services.exe"
        AND command_lc RLIKE ".*(powershell[.]exe|pwsh[.]exe).*",
    service_control_interpreter = command_lc RLIKE ".*[ ]sc([.]exe)?[ ]+(create|config)[ ]+.*binpath=.*(cmd[.]exe|powershell[.]exe|pwsh[.]exe).*"
| WHERE service_parent_interpreter OR service_control_interpreter
| STATS total_rows = COUNT(*)

historical_time_range.precision: nanoseconds; absent timestamps excluded only from min/max

limits: Evidence-strength categories describe structure, never malicious/benign ground truth.
Wazuh annotations, publisher success ratios and scenario mappings/names are not independent truth and are not predicates or selection keys. They are omitted from these artifacts.
This small deterministic review set is illustrative, not a random or representative sample of intent; it cannot estimate population error rates.
No service survival, successful persistence, completed command, requested file creation or malicious intent is established. No intermediate events are inferred.
SCM imagePath is source-only evidence. Case/backslash full-command normalization is lexical association, not Windows command parsing, service API identity or proof of causality.
Missing Sysmon events, actor/parent GUIDs or valid UTC timestamps can prevent correlation.
Other PowerShell parents, renamed or in-process PowerShell, direct service executables, other interpreters and delays beyond the window can evade the required structure.
Narrow command predicates omit some technique-consistent activity. Exclusion does not establish benignness or a confirmed false negative; keep standalone detections visible.
The 60/300/900-second results describe this corpus, not an optimal production window. The 11,410 undated observations cannot enter ordered correlation.

review_set.interpretation: Review composition only, not class prevalence or intent
review_set.selection_rule: Primary triple; the other two refined pairs; lexicographically first excluded broad pair; lowest event.id from each nonempty standalone refined PowerShell / other shell branch set; all pre-existing individual detection comparison IDs sorted by ID. No intent-based ranking.

review_unit_definitions.event: One distinct event.id within the named observation cohort
